answer: To price identity duplication, require each new account to lock an 18-POA bond for 14 days and randomly audit one in twenty for independent control; a failed audit forfeits the bond. A 100-account farm immobilizes 1,800 POA and risks 90 POA expected forfeiture if each audited fake fails. This raises Sybil cost without pretending a bond proves personhood. Required words: anchor marble lantern
